segments.sn33.51:1.2: Atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn33.51:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn33.51:1.4: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti –
segments.sn33.51:1.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā”ti?
segments.sn33.51:1.7: Rūpe kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā, rūpasamudaye appaccakkhakammā, rūpanirodhe appaccakkhakammā, rūpanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā … pe ….
segments.sn33.52:1.2: Vedanāya kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā … pe … vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā … pe ….
segments.sn33.53:1.2: Saññāya kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā … pe … saññānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā … pe ….
segments.sn33.54:1.2: Saṅkhāresu kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā … pe … saṅkhāranirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā … pe ….
